title.source_quote: FRAMEWORK ACT ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND THE CREATION OF A FOUNDATION FOR TRUST
title.why: The register title matches KLRI's English title word for word (title case). original_title '인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법' matches the stored law.go.kr print character for character. KLRI drops '등' ('etc.'), as it usually does. The title is 'official' only in the sense of the government's reference translation.

summary_claims.claim: Operators of high-impact or generative AI must notify users in advance that AI is used, label generative AI outputs, and clearly mark realistic synthetic media (Art. 31).
summary_claims.original_quote: ③ 인공지능사업자는 인공지능시스템을 이용하여 실제와 구분하기 어려운 가상의 음향, 이미지 또는 영상 등의 결과물을 제공하는 경우 해당 결과물이 인공지능시스템에 의하여 생성되었다는 사실을 이용자가 명확하게 인식할 수 있는 방식으로 고지 또는 표시하여야 한다.
summary_claims.literal_translation: (3) Where an AI business operator provides, using an AI system, outputs such as virtual sounds, images or videos that are hard to distinguish from reality, it shall give notice or mark, in a way the user can clearly recognise, that the output was generated by an AI system.
summary_claims.note: Paras 1-2 are rendered correctly (prior notice for products/services using high-impact or generative AI; marking of generative-AI outputs). Two nuances in para 3: it applies to any operator using an AI system, not only operators of high-impact or generative AI as the sentence structure suggests; and it allows notice or marking (고지 또는 표시), not only marking. The artistic-work softening is not mentioned.

summary_claims.claim: Operators of AI trained with compute above a decree-set threshold must identify, assess and mitigate risks across the life cycle and run incident monitoring and response (Art. 32).
summary_claims.original_quote: 인공지능사업자는 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 대통령령으로 정하는 기준 이상인 인공지능시스템의 안전성을 확보하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 이행하여야 한다. 1. 인공지능 수명주기 전반에 걸친 위험의 식별ㆍ평가 및 완화 2. 인공지능 관련 안전사고를 모니터링하고 대응하는 위험관리체계 구축
summary_claims.literal_translation: An AI business operator shall, to ensure the safety of an AI system whose cumulative compute used for training is at or above the standard set by Presidential Decree, carry out the following: 1. identification, assessment and mitigation of risks throughout the AI life cycle; 2. building a risk-management system that monitors and responds to AI-related safety incidents.
summary_claims.note: 'Above' should strictly be 'at or above' (이상). The duty under Art. 32(2) to submit the results to the Minister is not mentioned.

summary_claims.claim: High-impact AI operators must confirm high-impact status, adopt risk management, explainability, user protection and human oversight measures, and should conduct fundamental-rights impact assessments (Arts. 33–35).
summary_claims.locator: PDF page 182, annex 1 (Act No. 20676), Art. 33(1) and Art. 35(1)
summary_claims.original_quote: 그 인공지능이 고영향 인공지능에 해당하는지에 대하여 사전에 검토하여야 하며, 필요한 경우 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 고영향 인공지능에 해당하는지 여부의 확인을 요청할 수 있다.
summary_claims.literal_translation: [the operator] shall review in advance whether the AI falls under high-impact AI and may, where necessary, request the Minister of Science and ICT to confirm whether it falls under high-impact AI.
summary_claims.note: Art. 33(1) imposes a prior self-review (사전에 검토). 'Confirmation' (확인) is the Act's word for the optional step in which the Minister confirms status on request. 'Must confirm high-impact status' can therefore be read as a mandatory confirmation. The Art. 34 measures are rendered correctly. Art. 35(1) is an effort duty ('평가...하기 위하여 노력하여야 한다'), which 'should' captures, but the Act calls it simply 영향평가 (impact assessment) of the impact on people's fundamental rights, not a 'fundamental-rights impact assessment'.

key_terms.official_rendering: high-impact AI (MSIT's own gloss in the Art. 34 guideline, archive/KR-07/2026-10-12/official.pdf p. 11; 'High-Impact AI Systems' on the cover of the KR-06 guideline)
key_terms.note: The KLRI rendering cannot be read from the stored shell.

key_terms.official_rendering: AI business operator (MSIT gloss, archive/KR-07/2026-10-12/official.pdf p. 11)
key_terms.note: The Act's term covers both developers (인공지능개발사업자) and deploying businesses (인공지능이용사업자), and it includes state bodies (국가기관등). The register's 'operators' is fine. 국내대리인 'domestic agent' also matches MSIT's gloss.

Art. 35 is headed 'high-impact AI impact assessment' and defines 영향평가 as assessing the impact on people's fundamental rights. MSIT's Art. 35 guideline (KR-08) calls it '인공지능 영향평가' and keeps '기본권 영향평가 (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment)' for the EU AI Act Art. 27 instrument. The register's label is defensible in substance but echoes the EU term.

issues: Summary: 'must confirm high-impact status' overstates Art. 33(1), which requires a prior self-review (사전에 검토); confirmation (확인) by the Minister is optional and on request.
Summary: 'fundamental-rights impact assessments' is not the Act's term (고영향 인공지능 영향평가 / 영향평가); MSIT reserves 'Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment' for the EU instrument.
Summary: Art. 31(3) applies to outputs of any AI system and allows notice or marking; the summary ties it to high-impact or generative AI operators and to marking only.

note: The notes' claims on Arts. 40, 43 and the Addenda match the enacted text (Art. 43(1): fines up to 3천만원 for failing to give the Art. 31(1) notice, failing to designate a domestic agent, or ignoring stop/correction orders; Addenda Art. 1: in force one year after promulgation, the Art. 2(4)(d) digital-medical-device part from 24 Jan 2026). 'Failing to give AI notice' is right: the fine covers only the prior notice of Art. 31(1), not the marking duties. The 26 Dec 2024 passage date and the 19 consolidated bills are not in stored text.
